title: The closer: the auditor's question
summary: The use of AI is on the record, and the firm's rules answer an auditor directly, link by link
story: Grace Whitfield of Internal Audit joins after the demo. Priya Nair opens the evidence record the demo wrote, then puts Grace's question twice: to the document chat, and to NexCODE, which walks the four layers from the standards to the policy clause to the regulation and cites every link. The answer goes on the record too.

card.about: The closer: the use of AI is itself on the record, and the firm's rules answer an auditor directly. The presenter opens the evidence record the last demo wrote, or an example record when none has run, then asks the auditor's question twice. The document chat answers from the documents as one pile. NexCODE searches each layer of rules on its own topics, reads each policy clause's "Traces to:" line and looks the regulation up in its own text, so the answer walks from the standard to the policy clause to the regulation, citing every link and naming any link it cannot find. The answer is recorded like any change.
card.scenario: Tuesday 14 July 2026. Grace Whitfield of Internal Audit is testing the payments engineering controls (IA-2026-14). Her questions: which of our standards require decimal arithmetic for money, and which regulation they trace to; and which rules govern code written with an AI assistant, and which regulator expectations they rest on. Priya Nair answers with NexCODE in front of her, and the answer goes on the record.

governance, human oversight and accountability of AI models
a senior manager responsible for the use of AI
corporate: AI-assisted development is software development: existing controls apply
a human reviews and approves every AI-generated change
records of AI use are kept with the change record
sdlc: AI-generated changes are labelled and reviewed by a human
team: using an AI coding assistant on this team

talkTrack: The closer: the use of AI is itself on the record, and the firm's rules answer an auditor directly. Select the demo: nothing is reset, so the record the last demo wrote is still there. Show the latest record: the Results panel opens on it, with the model, the sources searched and cited, the tests and the approval, still pending. Then Grace's question, first through the document chat. It searches the documents as one pile; in the measured runs it found the standards and the team's notes but never reached the regulation. Then through NexCODE: each layer is searched on its own topics, each policy clause's "Traces to:" line is read and the regulation it names is looked up in its own text. The answer walks from PAY-012 to FIN-POL-003 clause 4.3 to the Payment Services Regulations, regulation 84, and SYSC 4.1.1R, citing every link, and names any link it cannot find. Optionally ask the AI-governance question too. Record the answer: the evidence record keeps the question, what each layer searched for, the passages cited and the chain.
